title: PARDUS Uragano EVO gravel bike review
notes: Dated 2023-11-29 exact-model review supports a carbon Uragano EVO frame, maximum 700×45C tires, front/rear rack, fork, bottle and fender mounts, and a 9.65 kg no-pedals weight for its Apex AXS/X1 Eagle AXS build.
